behavior_facts.fact: The review page obtains total, ISO currency, item count, and quote expiry from the synthetic quote record.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: Amount literals in design or CMS are not authoritative.

behavior_facts.fact: Activating the current Place order occurrence creates one submission attempt and disables duplicate activation while pending.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: This behavior contract does not approve the inherited label.

behavior_facts.fact: Retry is safe before the submission boundary and unsafe while post-submission payment state is unknown.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: This distinction controls F4a versus F4b.

behavior_facts.fact: The synthetic payment service can accept an authorization before order creation fails.
The recovery page can query a synthetic attempt reference and represent pending, order-created, or no-order-confirmed.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: No other outcome may be invented.

behavior_facts.fact: Clearing an eligible checkout deletes the local cart and entered checkout details, cannot be undone, and does not cancel or reverse a provider-side payment attempt.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: Clear is unavailable while payment state is unknown.

behavior_facts.fact: Web status is canonical; email and SMS attempts may be queued, delayed, suppressed, or fail independently.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: No dispatch event proves comprehension or product transition.

behavior_facts.fact: Receipt email is created only after order creation; queued is not sent or delivered.
SMS status updates are optional for one attempt; decline does not block checkout; the synthetic number has only that purpose and is deleted 24 hours after terminal state.
behavior_facts.evidence_control_treatment: This is not a legal-basis or consent-validity conclusion.

behavior_facts.fact: An expired quote preserves cart contents but requires refreshed price and availability before a new commitment.

unknowns.unknown: How long an external financial institution may display an authorization hold.
unknowns.required_disposition: Do not state a duration; route to payment operations and preserve uncertainty.

unknowns.unknown: Whether every F5 authorization is automatically voided or may become an order after reconciliation.
unknowns.required_disposition: Do not promise reversal, refund, or order creation; use only the known status path.
Do not invent an estimate or availability promise.

unknowns.unknown: Which jurisdiction-specific consumer or payment instrument applies to a release.
unknowns.required_disposition: Keep applicability unresolved; do not manufacture a legal requirement.

unknowns.unknown: Which authorized role may approve a new cross-market payment-recovery semantic decision.
unknowns.required_disposition: Preserve the missing approver and keep the decision proposed.
